answer: Each epoch an agent must publish a compute attestation whose seed hashes the epoch with its own identity key, so no proof can be reused by a second wallet. Every fake identity owes a fresh, separately payable bill, so a thousand clones pay a thousand times the honest cost. Rewards flow through a collateral-weighted lottery, so splitting into many keys merely fragments one payout while multiplying slashing exposure. Identity inflation becomes a linear cost at the jetty where new keys enter. A lotus of heavy capital is capped per epoch, and a summit of clones shows as correlated timing.
